Brand, content and communications • Create a distinctive brand position and a compelling, differentiated proposition, backed by strong messaging and clear points of difference. • Build credibility and authority in the medical education market. • Develop a content and communications strategy. • Ensure consistent messaging across advertising, the website, email, and social channels. • Identify opportunities for partnerships, influencers, professional communities, and content-led growth. Skills and Experience: The following are considered essential: • 7+ years of marketing experience, including senior leadership responsibility  • A track record of growing digital or subscription businesses with recurring revenue. • A strong understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversion, and subscription economics. • Experience developing and optimising digital marketing funnels. • The ability to work independently and execute campaigns hands-on. • Experience working with international markets. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable experience: • EdTech or online education. • Healthcare, medical technology or medical publishing. • Experience working remotely with international businesses. Success in this role means building a marketing function that can grow customer acquisition and revenue, improve subscription conversion and retention, and make it easy to see which activities are delivering commercial returns.
